summary: The filing is an 8-K under Item 8.01 (Other Events) reporting an investment guideline change for PIMCO Global StocksPLUS & Income Fund (NYSE: PGP). Effective July 24, 2026, the Fund may invest without limitation in senior floating-rate loans. The change will be reflected in the annual N-CSR for the period ended June 30, 2026. No special situation (M&A, tender, activist, restructuring, etc.) is present. The Fund's board authorized the change; no advisor, premium, or deal mechanics are mentioned. A routine operational update, not a special situation.
